en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a peacefully flowing river lined with trees and cows standing beneath them. The background features rolling hills and a small waterfall. The front of the postcard bears the printed text 'Bad Pyrmont - Partie an der Emmer' in red. The reverse side of the postcard is formatted for correspondence and address, featuring German text and the stamp of the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' There are hand-written numbers and a printed note of '1905' and publishing information from Dresden.
